commands.title: List running containers
commands.description: Shows containers that are currently running.

commands.title: List all containers including stopped
commands.description: Includes exited containers, useful for finding ones to restart or remove.

commands.title: List container IDs only
commands.description: Prints just the IDs of all containers, handy for scripting.

commands.title: Show containers with a custom format
commands.description: Prints a compact table of name, image, status and ports.

commands.title: Filter containers by name
commands.description: Lists containers whose name contains the given text.

commands.title: List exited containers
commands.description: Shows only containers that have stopped.

commands.title: List local images
commands.description: Shows images stored locally with tag, ID and size.

commands.title: List dangling images
commands.description: Shows untagged images left behind by rebuilds.

commands.title: Run a container in the background
commands.description: Starts a detached container with a name.

commands.title: Run a container with a port mapping
commands.description: Publishes a container port on the host.

commands.title: Run an interactive throwaway container
commands.description: Opens a shell in a new container that is deleted on exit. Use bash if the image has it.

commands.title: Run a container with environment variables
commands.description: Passes an environment variable into the container; repeat -e for more.

commands.title: Run a container with an env file
commands.description: Loads environment variables from a file in the current directory.

commands.title: Run a container with a bind mount
commands.description: Mounts the current directory into the container at /app.

commands.title: Run a container with a named volume
commands.description: Stores /data in a named volume so it survives container removal.

commands.title: Run a container that restarts automatically
commands.description: Restarts the container after crashes and reboots unless you stop it manually.

commands.title: Run a container on a network
commands.description: Attaches the new container to an existing network.

commands.title: Run a container with resource limits
commands.description: Caps memory and CPU use; the container is killed if it exceeds the memory limit.

commands.title: Open a shell in a running container
commands.description: Starts an interactive shell inside the container. Use bash if available.

commands.title: Run a command in a running container
commands.description: Runs a single command in the container and prints its output.

commands.title: Open a shell as root in a container
commands.description: Useful when the image runs as an unprivileged user.

commands.title: Follow a container's logs
commands.description: Shows the last 100 lines and keeps streaming new output until you press Ctrl+C.

commands.title: Show logs from the last 10 minutes
commands.description: Prints only recent log lines; accepts durations like 30s or 2h.

commands.title: Show logs with timestamps
commands.description: Prefixes each of the last 50 lines with its timestamp.

commands.title: Build an image from a Dockerfile
commands.description: Builds from the Dockerfile in the current directory and tags the result.

commands.title: Build without cache
commands.description: Forces every step to run again, which is slower but avoids stale layers.

commands.title: Build with a specific Dockerfile
commands.description: Uses a Dockerfile with a non-default name or path.

commands.title: Build with a build argument
commands.description: Sets an ARG declared in the Dockerfile.

commands.title: Tag an image
commands.description: Adds another name to an existing image, typically before pushing.

commands.title: Push an image to a registry
commands.description: Uploads the image; run docker login first for private registries.

commands.title: Pull an image
commands.description: Downloads an image or updates the local copy of that tag.

commands.title: Log in to a registry
commands.description: Prompts for credentials and stores them for later pushes and pulls.

commands.title: Stop a container
commands.description: Sends SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 10 seconds.

commands.title: Start a stopped container
commands.description: Starts an existing container with its previous configuration.

commands.title: Restart a container
commands.description: Stops and starts the container again.

commands.title: Remove a container
commands.description: Deletes a stopped container; its anonymous volumes remain unless you add -v.

commands.title: Force remove a running container
commands.description: Kills and deletes the container immediately.

commands.title: Remove all stopped containers
commands.description: Deletes every stopped container after a confirmation prompt.

commands.title: Remove an image
commands.description: Deletes a local image; fails if a container still uses it.

commands.title: Remove all unused images
commands.description: Deletes every image not used by a container. Asks before it runs.

commands.title: Remove dangling images
commands.description: Deletes untagged images only. Asks before it runs.

commands.title: Clear the build cache
commands.description: Removes dangling build cache after a confirmation prompt; add -a to remove all of it.

commands.title: Remove all build cache
commands.description: Deletes all build cache, so the next builds start cold.

commands.title: Remove all unused images, containers and networks
commands.description: Deletes every stopped container, unused network and image not used by a container. Asks before it runs.

commands.title: Show Docker disk usage
commands.description: Summarizes space used by images, containers, volumes and build cache.

commands.title: Inspect a container
commands.description: Prints the full JSON configuration and state of a container.

commands.title: Get a container's IP address
commands.description: Prints the IP on each network the container is attached to.

commands.title: Show live resource usage
commands.description: Streams CPU, memory, network and disk I/O for running containers.

commands.title: Show resource usage once
commands.description: Prints a single snapshot instead of streaming.

commands.title: Copy a file from a container to the host
commands.description: Copies a file or directory out of the container into the current directory.

commands.title: Copy a file from the host into a container
commands.description: Copies a local file into the container's filesystem.

commands.title: List networks
commands.description: Shows all Docker networks and their drivers.

commands.title: Create a network
commands.description: Creates a user-defined bridge network where containers resolve each other by name.

commands.title: Inspect a network
commands.description: Shows the subnet and the containers attached to a network.

commands.title: List volumes
commands.description: Shows all local volumes.

commands.title: Create a volume
commands.description: Creates a named volume for persistent data.

commands.title: Inspect a volume
commands.description: Shows the volume's mountpoint and driver.

commands.title: Remove a volume
commands.description: Permanently deletes the volume and its data; fails if a container uses it.

commands.title: Save an image to a tar file
commands.description: Exports an image so it can be moved to a machine without registry access.

commands.title: Load an image from a tar file
commands.description: Imports an image previously exported with docker save.

commands.title: Show processes in a container
commands.description: Lists the processes running inside the container.

commands.title: Show a container's port mappings
commands.description: Prints how container ports map to host ports.

commands.title: Rename a container
commands.description: Changes the container's name without recreating it.

commands.title: Change a container's restart policy
commands.description: Updates the restart policy of an existing container without recreating it.

commands.title: Show Docker version and daemon info
commands.description: Prints server details such as storage driver, runtime and container counts.

commands.title: Start services in the background
commands.description: Creates and starts all services defined in the compose file.

commands.title: Rebuild images and start services
commands.description: Rebuilds images before starting so code changes are picked up.

commands.title: Start in the foreground
commands.description: Streams logs from all services; Ctrl+C stops them.

commands.title: Stop and remove services
commands.description: Removes containers and networks but keeps named volumes.

commands.title: Stop and remove services and volumes
commands.description: Also deletes named volumes declared in the file, wiping their data.

commands.title: List the project's containers
commands.description: Shows the status of the services in this project.

commands.title: Follow logs of all services
commands.description: Streams the last 100 lines of every service until you press Ctrl+C.

commands.title: Follow logs of one service
commands.description: Streams logs for a single service.

commands.title: Open a shell in a service
commands.description: Starts an interactive shell in the running service container.

commands.title: Run a one-off command in a service
commands.description: Starts a temporary container for the service and removes it afterwards.

commands.title: Restart a service
commands.description: Restarts the service container without rebuilding it.

commands.title: Pull the latest images
commands.description: Downloads newer images for every service; run up -d afterwards to apply.

commands.title: Validate and print the resolved config
commands.description: Shows the merged compose file with variables substituted and catches syntax errors.

commands.title: Stop services without removing them
commands.description: Stops containers but keeps them and their data.

commands.title: Start existing stopped services
commands.description: Starts containers that were previously stopped.

commands.title: Show processes of services
commands.description: Lists processes running inside each service container.

commands.title: List images used by the project
commands.description: Shows the images behind each service container.

commands.title: Scale a service
commands.description: Runs three replicas of a service; it must not publish a fixed host port.

commands.title: Use a specific compose file
commands.description: Starts services from a compose file other than the default.

commands.title: Combine compose files
commands.description: Merges an override file over the base file.

commands.title: Use a project name
commands.description: Sets the project name, so the same file can run side by side as separate stacks.

commands.title: Rebuild a service without cache
commands.description: Rebuilds the service image from scratch.

commands.title: Remove orphan containers on down
commands.description: Also removes containers for services no longer in the compose file.

commands.title: List pods
commands.description: Shows pods in the current namespace.

commands.title: List pods with node and IP
commands.description: Adds node, pod IP and other columns.

commands.title: List pods in all namespaces
commands.description: Shows pods across the whole cluster.

commands.title: List pods in a namespace
commands.description: Shows pods in the given namespace.

commands.title: List pods by label
commands.description: Filters pods using a label selector.

commands.title: Watch pods change
commands.description: Streams updates as pods change state; Ctrl+C to stop.

commands.title: List services
commands.description: Shows services in the current namespace.

commands.title: List deployments
commands.description: Shows deployments with ready and available replica counts.

commands.title: List nodes
commands.description: Shows nodes with status, version and IPs.

commands.title: List most resources in all namespaces
commands.description: Shows pods, services, deployments and more; it omits ingresses, configmaps and secrets.

commands.title: Describe a pod
commands.description: Shows pod details and recent events, the first stop for crash loops.

commands.title: Describe a node
commands.description: Shows capacity, allocated resources, conditions and events.

commands.title: Show a pod's YAML
commands.description: Prints the live manifest including status.

commands.title: Follow a pod's logs
commands.description: Streams logs until you press Ctrl+C.

commands.title: Show the previous container's logs
commands.description: Prints logs from the last crashed container instance.

commands.title: Show logs of a specific container
commands.description: Picks one container in a multi-container pod.

commands.title: Show recent logs
commands.description: Limits output to the last 15 minutes and 200 lines.

commands.title: Open a shell in a pod
commands.description: Starts an interactive shell. Add -c <container> for multi-container pods.

commands.title: Run a command in a pod
commands.description: Runs one command in the pod and prints its output.

commands.title: Apply a manifest
commands.description: Creates or updates resources from a file.

commands.title: Preview a change with diff
commands.description: Shows what apply would change without changing anything.

commands.title: Delete resources from a manifest
commands.description: Deletes every resource defined in the file.

commands.title: Delete a pod
commands.description: Deletes the pod; a controller will usually recreate it.

commands.title: Check rollout status
commands.description: Waits and reports until the rollout finishes or fails.

commands.title: Restart a deployment
commands.description: Recreates the pods gradually with a rolling update.

commands.title: Roll back a deployment
commands.description: Reverts to the previous revision.

commands.title: Show rollout history
commands.description: Lists the recorded revisions of a deployment.

commands.title: Scale a deployment
commands.description: Sets the number of replicas.

commands.title: Forward a local port to a pod
commands.description: Makes a pod port reachable on localhost until you press Ctrl+C.

commands.title: Forward a local port to a service
commands.description: Tunnels localhost to a service port.

commands.title: List contexts
commands.description: Shows configured clusters and which context is active.

commands.title: Switch context
commands.description: Changes the active cluster and user.

commands.title: Show the current context
commands.description: Prints the name of the active context.

commands.title: Set the default namespace
commands.description: Saves a namespace on the current context so -n is not needed.

commands.title: Show pod resource usage
commands.description: Shows CPU and memory per pod; needs metrics-server.

commands.title: Show node resource usage
commands.description: Shows CPU and memory per node; needs metrics-server.

commands.title: Create a namespace
commands.description: Creates a new namespace.

commands.title: List namespaces
commands.description: Shows all namespaces in the cluster.

commands.title: List events by time
commands.description: Shows recent events oldest to newest, useful for debugging scheduling problems.

commands.title: Copy a file from a pod
commands.description: Copies a file out of a pod; the container needs tar installed.

commands.title: Copy a file into a pod
commands.description: Copies a local file into a pod; the container needs tar installed.

commands.title: Update a deployment's image
commands.description: Triggers a rolling update to the new image.

commands.title: Cordon a node
commands.description: Marks a node unschedulable without touching running pods.

commands.title: Drain a node
commands.description: Evicts pods from the node, discarding emptyDir data. Use before maintenance.

commands.title: Uncordon a node
commands.description: Makes a node schedulable again.

commands.title: Check whether you can do something
commands.description: Answers yes or no for your current user; add --as to test another identity.

commands.title: List everything you can do
commands.description: Shows the permissions of the current user in the namespace.

commands.title: Decode a secret value
commands.description: Prints one secret key decoded; avoid running it on shared screens.

commands.title: Run a temporary debug pod
commands.description: Starts a throwaway pod with a shell for testing connectivity.

commands.title: Add a chart repository
commands.description: Registers a chart repository under a local name.

commands.title: Update chart repositories
commands.description: Refreshes the local index of every added repository.

commands.title: Search for a chart
commands.description: Finds charts in the added repositories.

commands.title: List releases
commands.description: Shows installed releases in all namespaces.

commands.title: Install a chart
commands.description: Installs a chart as a named release, creating the namespace if needed.

commands.title: Install with a values file
commands.description: Overrides chart defaults with your values file.

commands.title: Upgrade or install a release
commands.description: Upgrades the release, or installs it if it does not exist yet.

commands.title: Render templates locally
commands.description: Prints the Kubernetes manifests without touching the cluster.

commands.title: Show a release's history
commands.description: Lists revisions, which you can roll back to.

commands.title: Roll back a release
commands.description: Reverts the release to a given revision.

commands.title: Uninstall a release
commands.description: Deletes the release and the resources it created.

commands.title: Show a chart's default values
commands.description: Prints values.yaml, a good start for your own overrides.

commands.title: Show the current AWS identity
commands.description: Prints the account, user ARN and ID behind the active credentials.

commands.title: Configure credentials
commands.description: Prompts for access key, secret key, default region and output format.

commands.title: Configure a named profile
commands.description: Stores credentials under a separate profile name.

commands.title: Configure SSO login
commands.description: Walks through setting up an IAM Identity Center profile.

commands.title: Log in with SSO
commands.description: Opens the browser to refresh SSO credentials.

commands.title: List S3 buckets
commands.description: Shows all buckets in the account.

commands.title: List objects in a bucket
commands.description: Lists every object with sizes and a total.

commands.title: Copy a file to S3
commands.description: Uploads a local file.

commands.title: Download a file from S3
commands.description: Downloads an object into the current directory.

commands.title: Sync a folder to S3
commands.description: Uploads new and changed files; add --delete to remove extras remotely.

commands.title: Delete an object from S3
commands.description: Permanently deletes one object, or a versioned marker if versioning is on.

commands.title: Delete everything under an S3 prefix
commands.description: Deletes all matching objects; try --dryrun first.

commands.title: List EC2 instances in a table
commands.description: Shows ID, state, type, IP and Name tag for each instance in the region.

commands.title: List running EC2 instances
commands.description: Prints IDs of running instances only.

commands.title: Log Docker in to ECR
commands.command: aws ecr get-login-password --region <region> | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin <account-id>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com
commands.description: Authenticates Docker against your private ECR registry; the token lasts 12 hours.

commands.title: Tail CloudWatch logs
commands.description: Streams log events from a log group until you press Ctrl+C.

commands.title: Start an SSM session
commands.description: Opens a shell on an instance without SSH; needs the Session Manager plugin.

commands.title: List Lambda functions
commands.description: Shows the names of functions in the region.

commands.title: Invoke a Lambda function
commands.description: Runs the function with an empty JSON payload and writes the response to out.json.

commands.title: Invalidate a CloudFront cache
commands.description: Clears cached copies at the edge; large numbers of paths can incur cost.

commands.title: Describe ElastiCache clusters
commands.description: Lists clusters with node endpoints.

commands.title: Describe RDS instances
commands.description: Shows identifier, engine, status and endpoint of each database.

commands.title: Run a command with a profile and region
commands.description: Overrides the default profile and region for a single call.

commands.title: Use a profile for the whole shell
commands.description: Makes later aws commands in this shell use that profile.

commands.title: Initialize a working directory
commands.description: Downloads providers and modules and configures the backend.

commands.title: Upgrade providers
commands.description: Re-resolves providers and modules to the newest allowed versions.

commands.title: Preview changes
commands.description: Shows what Terraform would create, change or destroy.

commands.title: Save a plan to a file
commands.description: Saves the plan so apply runs exactly what you reviewed.

commands.title: Apply changes
commands.description: Shows the plan and asks for confirmation before changing infrastructure.

commands.title: Apply a saved plan
commands.description: Applies exactly the saved plan without another prompt.

commands.title: Apply without confirmation
commands.description: Skips the approval prompt, so use it only when you trust the plan.

commands.title: Destroy all managed infrastructure
commands.description: Deletes every resource in the state after you confirm.

commands.title: Format configuration files
commands.description: Rewrites .tf files to canonical style in this directory and below.

commands.title: Validate the configuration
commands.description: Checks syntax and internal consistency without contacting providers.

commands.title: Show outputs
commands.description: Prints all root module outputs; add a name for a single value.

commands.title: List resources in state
commands.description: Shows the addresses of every resource Terraform tracks.

commands.title: Show a resource in state
commands.description: Prints the recorded attributes of one resource.

commands.title: Remove a resource from state
commands.description: Stops tracking the resource without destroying it; Terraform may try to recreate it later.

commands.title: Import an existing resource
commands.description: Brings an existing real resource under Terraform management.

commands.title: List workspaces
commands.description: Shows workspaces, with an asterisk on the current one.

commands.title: Select a workspace
commands.description: Switches to another state workspace.

commands.title: Create a workspace
commands.description: Creates and switches to a new workspace with empty state.

commands.title: Plan a single resource
commands.description: Limits the plan to one resource and its dependencies; avoid it as a routine habit.

commands.title: Apply with a variables file
commands.description: Loads variable values from the given file.
